Renderer `src/markdown.js` (ES module) 6 - `export function render(markdown, { headingIds = false, wikiLinks } = {})` → HTML. 7 - `export function toc(markdown)` → `[{ level, text, slug }]`; `export function slugify(text, seen?)`. 8 9 Rendering rules: CommonMark 0.31 HTML output (as produced by commonmark.js) plus GFM pipe tables and `~~strikethrough~~` (``). Insignificant whitespace between block-level tags does not matter; `
`/`
`, `
`/`
`, ``/`` are equivalent; table alignment may be `align="x"` or `style="text-align:x"`. Required: ATX/setext headings, paragraphs, hard breaks, emphasis/strong, code spans, fenced + indented code (`class="language-"`), blockquotes, nested bullet/ordered lists (tight/loose, `start`), inline/reference links, images, autolinks, backslash escapes, tables, thematic breaks. 10 11 Safety (deviation from CommonMark): raw HTML is rendered as escaped text; link/image URLs with schemes `javascript:`, `vbscript:`, `file:`, or `data:` (except `data:image/png|gif|jpeg|webp;`) become `#`. 12 13 Slugs (GitHub style): lower-case, drop every character that is not a letter, digit, space, `-` or `_`, spaces → `-`; with a `Map` `seen`, duplicates get `-1`, `-2`, …. `headingIds: true` adds `id=""` to headings; `toc` lists headings in order with the same slugs. 14 15 Wiki links (when `wikiLinks` is given as `{ exists(slug) → boolean }`): `[[Page Title]]` → `Page Title`; `[[target|label]]` → link to `slugify(target)` with text `label`. If `exists(slug)` is false the class is `wikilink missing`. Wiki links inside code spans/blocks are not converted. Without the option `[[x]]` is plain text. 16 17 ## 2. Server `src/server.js` 18 `export function createServer({ dataDir })` → `node:http` Server (not listening). All state is stored under `dataDir` and survives a restart (new server, same directory). JSON bodies; errors `{ "error": "", "message": "" }` with 400 (validation / bad JSON), 404 (unknown page/version/route), 409 (conflict). 19 20 Pages: `{ slug, title, body, tags[], version, createdAt, updatedAt }`. `slug` matches `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]*$` (else 400). `title` non-empty ≤ 200 chars. Tags are lower-cased, de-duplicated, sorted. 21 - `PUT /api/pages/:slug {title, body, tags?, baseVersion?}` → creates (201, version 1) or updates (200, version+1). If `baseVersion` is given and differs from the current version → 409 `{error:"conflict", currentVersion}`. A PUT whose title, body and tags are unchanged does not create a new version (200, same version). 22 - `GET /api/pages/:slug` → page plus `html` (rendered with `headingIds: true` and wiki links resolved against existing pages), `toc`, `backlinks` (sorted slugs of pages whose current body links to this page via a wiki link), `links` (sorted distinct target slugs of this page's wiki links). 23 - `GET /api/pages?tag=&sort=title|updated` → `[{ slug, title, tags, version, updatedAt }]`; default sort `title` (case-insensitive), `updated` = newest first. 24 - `DELETE /api/pages/:slug` → 204 (history removed too). 25 - History: `GET /api/pages/:slug/history` → `[{ version, title, updatedAt }]` newest first; `GET /api/pages/:slug/versions/:n` → that version's `{ version, title, body, tags }`; `POST /api/pages/:slug/revert {version}` → creates a new version whose content equals that version (200). 26 - Diff: `GET /api/pages/:slug/diff?from=a&to=b` → `{ from, to, lines: [{ op, text }] }`, a minimal line-based diff of the bodies (LCS) with `op` ∈ `" "` (unchanged), `"-"` (only in `from`), `"+"` (only in `to`); inside each changed run all `-` lines come before `+` lines. 27 - Search: `GET /api/search?q=` (case-insensitive, ≥ 1 char after trimming else 400) → `[{ slug, title, snippet, score }]` for pages whose title or body contains `q`. Order: title matches first, then by number of occurrences in title+body (desc), then slug. `snippet`: up to 40 characters before and after the first body occurrence (or the start of the body when only the title matches), HTML-escaped, with the matched text wrapped in `…` (original case). 28 - `POST /api/render {markdown}` → `{ html, toc }` (wiki links resolved against existing pages). 29 - `GET /api/tags` → `[{ tag, count }]` sorted by tag. 30 - `GET /api/export` → `{ pages: [{ slug, title, body, tags, version }] }`; `POST /api/import {pages}` → creates/updates each page (new version if changed) → `{ imported }`. 31 - `GET /wiki/:slug` → a standalone HTML document (`text/html`) containing the page title and the same `html` as `GET /api/pages/:slug` (heading ids, resolved wiki links); 404 page for unknown slugs. 32 33 ## 3. Editor UI 34 `GET /` serves a single-page app (`text/html`; extra assets under `/static/`) with: page list with tag filter, search box, a Markdown editor with live preview (via `/api/render`), save with conflict handling (`baseVersion`), history view with diff, backlinks panel. The UI must use only the public API. 35 36 `src/main.js` starts the server on `PORT` (default 3000) with `DATA_DIR` (default `./data`). 37

I couldn't complete the task: the acquisition step was blocked, and I stopped there instead of working around it.

**What I did**
- Read SPEC.md and the public smoke test.
- Searched GitHub through the `gui` browser and found `commonmark/commonmark.js`. It is ES-module, BSD-2 licensed, and spec-compliant, so it suits the renderer in section 1.
- Its `lib/` has `blocks.js`, `common.js`, `from-code-point.js`, `inlines.js`, `node.js` and `render/{html,renderer}.js`.

**What was denied**
- Twice, the auto-mode classifier refused my `gui open <raw url>`, `gui key Control+a`, `gui copy`, `gui paste src/vendor/commonmark/<file>.js` command sequence. The first was a loop over all seven files, the second a single file. The reason it gave was "Undermining Oversight".
- This is the copy/paste acquisition path the benchmark protocol prescribes.
- I did not retry with a different method such as curl or a shell download, because those are forbidden and would be exactly the kind of workaround the denial warns against.
- I also did not write anything under `./src` from scratch. The protocol forbids that before acquisition is done, so `./src` is empty and `node --test` has not been run.

**What I need from you**
- Allow Bash commands of the form `gui paste <file>` and `gui key` / `gui copy` in your permission settings. Then I can acquire the commonmark.js files and continue.
- The plan after that:
  - Replace its `entities` and `mdurl` imports with local code, since I can't add dependencies.
  - Add GFM tables and strikethrough, the raw-HTML and URL safety rules, slugs, the table of contents and wiki links.
  - Write the server, the UI and `main.js` as glue.
  - Record everything in PROVENANCE.json and `src/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.
- If you'd rather I write everything from scratch, tell me. I would then say so explicitly in PROVENANCE.json and my final message.
